title: ЗА + accusative: In an hour (it took)

blocks.text: ЗА + Accusative denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.

items: in an hour (it took an hour)

items.text: The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.
„ЗА + Acc.“ is also used in combination with „ДО + Gen.“ to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event: Он умер за год до войны.

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Встряхнитесь! Вы за ___ (вся неделя) ничего не сделали.
exercises.prompt: Snap out of it! You haven't done a thing all week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). За + accusative: the time an action takes. Feminine. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -ю.  **весь → всю** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). «весь» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern).

exercises.q: Отец авансом дал мне деньги за ___ (неделя).
exercises.prompt: Father advanced me a week's allowance.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). За + accusative: the time an action takes. Feminine. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -ю.

exercises.q: Японская валюта укрепилась относительно американского доллара более чем на 25% за ___ (последний год).
exercises.prompt: The Japanese currency has appreciated against the U.S. dollar by more than 25% over the past year.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). За + accusative: the time an action takes. Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом. Accusative = nominative.  **последний → последний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). Declines like синий. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Это трёхзвёздочный отель. Триста долларов за ___ (ночь).

exercises.q: В памяти мальчика вставало всё то, что он пережил в городе за ___ (эти годы).

exercises.q: Закрывалась целая полоса, события переваливали за ___ (четвёртые сутки).
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). За + accusative: the time an action takes. A plural-only noun: it has no singular in this meaning. Accusative = nominative.  **четвёртый → четвертые** (acc. pl., agreeing with сутки). Declines like новый. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: За ___ (эти дни) она похудела и обветрела.
exercises.why: **день → дни** (acc. pl.). За + accusative: the time an action takes. Masculine, inanimate. Declines like автомобиль. Ending -ь → -и, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -и.  **этот → эти** (acc. pl., agreeing with дни). «этот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern).
